input.title: col2 thought incorrectly rendered as table in context view
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- A
  - =view
    - Table
  - B
    - B1
  - C
    - C1
- D
  - B1
```

Activate Context View on `A/B/B1`. 

## Current Behavior

When the Context View for `B1` is open, the context `B` is incorrectly rendered as a table.  

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a661145f-a9ad-44b0-a86f-a83052469bbc)

## Expected Behavior

`B` should be rendered as a normal bulleted thought within the list of contexts in the open Context View. 

Table view col2 should only be rendered when the thought is a direct grandchild of a table. It should not be rendered in the context view.
